summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to show all available session data from the insights SQLite DB, including scores, stats, token breakdown, files touched, tool usage, implementation rationale, tradeoffs, codebase patterns, and all facet types with evidence.
summary.outcome: Designed a compact grouped layout (4 boxes: SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS), wrote a spec and implementation plan, and began subagent-driven execution through Task 4 (renderSignalsBox), with Tasks 1-3 completed.

repo: Facets are structured signals extracted from session transcripts via LLM: repeated user instructions, missing context signals, failure loops, skill signals, review-derived rules, repo gotchas, and workflow gaps
Sessions are cached in insights.db with has_facets=0 initially; backfilling runs LLM extraction for uncached sessions and marks has_facets=1 when done

The insights.db has 16 tables: sessions (2633 rows), tool_calls (16029), files_touched (10788), learnings (2269), friction (616), codebase_patterns (422), implementation_rationale (333), tradeoffs (248), review_rule_signals (212), missing_context_signals (189), repeated_user_instructions (103), failure_loops (102), skill_signals (55), suggestions (0 - empty), cache_meta (1)
The Codex companion script hits ENOBUFS on large repos due to internal buffer limits on git diff output

code.finding: Detail pane uses renderDetailContent to compose boxes; new boxes renderSummaryBox (rewritten), renderCodeBox, renderSignalsBox, and helper renderSubSection/renderEvidence added per plan

Facets struct contains evidence fields on repeated instructions, missing context, failure loops, skill signals (Friction + MissingInstruction), and review rules (Evidence, SourceKind, Strength, WhyReusable)
